### Source
Git history and GitHub PRs.

### What I searched
- `git log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -- exposed/Cargo.toml Cargo.toml`
- `git show 5b44d23 -- exposed/Cargo.toml Cargo.toml`
- `git show 80bacc1 -- exposed/Cargo.toml`
- `git blame -L 12,60 exposed/Cargo.toml`
- `git log --all --oneline --grep='warning\|linker\|unwind\|build' -i`
- `git log --all -G '__eh_frame|compact.unwind|linker_messages|debug *=|profile.dev' --oneline -- Cargo.toml exposed/Cargo.toml .cargo`
- Full bodies, comments, and reviews for PRs #41, #25, #23.

### Direct evidence
No history found that explicitly explains this linker warning.

### Circumstantial evidence
- [PR #41](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/41), johnnylarner, merged October 9, 2026, explains the native dependency change:
  > “Declaration resolution requires a separately installed Python environment to score funder profiles.”
  
  > “Polars adds native Rust dependencies and requires Chrono 0.4.41, which is pinned here.”

  The patch [5b44d23](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/commit/5b44d231fe17fe40493ca34d919b753cffa2b9e0) adds Polars 0.53.0 and weldrs 0.2.2 to the application. Current manifest lines 50–51 originate in this commit. This makes native dependency growth a plausible contributor to the oversized unwind section. It does **not** establish that this commit introduced the warning.

- [PR #23](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/23) previously used a separate Python Splink/DuckDB worker. Moving this functionality into the Rust process plausibly expands the executable’s linked code.
- Arrow and Parquet dependencies predate that migration: blame attributes current manifest lines 44–45 to October 2 commit `9c75ffd8`.
- PR #25 adds only `time` to the manifest; its body concerns database loading, without linker or binary-size discussion.
- PR #41 records “117 tests pass” and separately reports preexisting Clippy diagnostics. Neither discusses the `__eh_frame` warning.

### Gaps
No matching compact-unwind, linker-warning, or development-profile changes in the searched manifest/config history. PRs #41, #25, and #23 have no comments or reviews. I did not build historical revisions or measure their unwind sections, so the first affected commit remains unknown.

### Contradictions
None found. Successful tests in PR #41 are compatible with a nonfatal linker warning.
